newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine grains, oilseeds mixed on weather worry.
newsitem.headline: Argentine grains, oilseeds mixed on weather worry.

text.p: Argentine cash grain and oilseeds were mixed in technical position-closing Friday with traders nervous of being caught out by weekend weather changes in Argentina, the United States and China, dealers said.

Trade on the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange was thin and highly speculative, dealers said, with local weather worries including difficulties in wheat sowing due to excess rain in Buenos Aires province and not enough in Santa Fe and Cordoba.
Maize, wheat, soybeans and sunseeds all traded between $1 higher or lower, dealers said.
